plain: One who robs a place by force.

webster.text: One who strips by force; a plunderer.

example.quote: As a further provision for the efficacy of the federal powers, they took an oath mutually to defend and protect the united cities, to punish the violators of this oath, and to inflict vengeance on sacrilegious despoilers of the temple.
example.cite: The Federalist No. 18 (Madison, with Hamilton), Dec. 7, 1787
